name: Citrus spritz
preparation: Fill a tall glass with ice. Add the orange juice and lime juice, then stir gently. Top with sparkling water. Give it one slow stir and finish with an orange wheel. Serve immediately while the bubbles are fresh.

name: Ginger lime cooler
preparation: Add lime juice and simple syrup to a highball filled with ice. Stir to combine, then pour in the ginger beer. Lift the mixture once with a spoon, avoiding vigorous stirring. Garnish with fresh mint and a lime wedge.

name: Berry garden
preparation: Gently crush the berries in a shaker. Add lemon juice and syrup, then shake with ice for 10 seconds. Fine strain into a chilled stemmed glass. Taste and adjust with a little water if needed. Finish with a strawberry slice.

name: Cucumber fizz
preparation: Muddle cucumber gently with lime juice in a shaker. Add the syrup and ice, then shake briefly. Strain into a tall glass with fresh ice. Add sparkling water and stir gently. Drape a cucumber ribbon inside the glass.

name: Pineapple sunset
preparation: Fill a highball with ice. Mix the pineapple juice, orange juice and lime juice in the glass. Pour the pomegranate juice slowly over the back of a spoon so it settles near the bottom. Serve with a spoon so the drink can be stirred before drinking.

name: Mint tea tonic
preparation: Brew the mint tea according to its packet instructions and allow it to cool completely. Fill a tall glass with ice. Add the tea and lemon juice. Top with tonic water, stir once and finish with a mint sprig. Use a small amount of syrup if you prefer a sweeter drink.
